content: Run gunicorn as a systemd service (not bare process) for auto-restart on crash and boot. Use a dedicated non-root system user, Restart=on-failure (or always), RuntimeDirectory for unix sockets so /run paths survive reboot, journald for centralized logs. Test by rebooting once to confirm auto-start. This is the standard production pattern, well corroborated across DigitalOcean/community guides.
